## 席位核对
ACCEPT — PR #36529 @ `6db1538b38121fa2b876e268eb51df70365397ac` · card #36507 · L1 read by area s2-D itself (seat area order item 9), at 2026-11-22T18:30Z

- Shape: draft → `main`; first line `Fixes #36507` (merge delivers every Done-when line); no closing keyword on another card; `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none` in body and changeset (`l1-face.mjs --pr 36529`: all mechanical rows ok).
- Premise: measured by the dev on PR #36461's head `5af2f6e3` — the drill keeps `{ crm_account: { industry: V } }` as the list's base filter, and `toFilterNode` → `convertFiltersToAST` lowers it to `['crm_account', '=', { industry: V }]`; the ablation reproduces the card's chip 「所属客户：= [object Object]」.
- Diff read (16 files, +345/−12): `readViewConditions` reads the nested form written and lowered into one locked `equals` chip on `<lookup>.<field>`; a plain-object value in a triple is never printed (unreadable nested shapes fall to the field-less 「View filter」 chip). `useRelatedConditionFields` reads `getObjectSchema(referenceTo)` once per related target, keyed on target names, only while such a chip is shown; labels via `useSafeFieldLabel` with declared-label then raw-name fallback. `referenceTo` is already populated on the host's fields (`ListView.tsx:2131`). One new key `listConditions.chips.relationPath` in all 11 packs. No new public ListView prop; no objectql or filter-execution change; chip stays locked.
- Delta `749ddb3e → 6db1538b` (+1/−4, `conditionModel.ts` only): the local `isPlainRecord` duplicated the `@objectstack/spec/data` export that `check:spec-symbols` refuses (the Type Check UI red); now imported from spec, which plugin-list already depends on.
- Tests: 6 cases in the shared harness `listConditions.test.tsx` (en, zh-CN, two fallbacks, a same-object CONTROL that reads no definition); ablation of the `tripleChip` plain-object arm ⇒ 5/6 red, CONTROL green, restored blob == HEAD. No existing test changed.
- Gates: check-runs at `6db1538b`: every check success or expected skip, 0 failed (`pr-state.mjs --pr 36529`); 41 derived gate families reconciled 0 NOT-MEASURED (`/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36507-gates-ran.txt`); `overlap-check` clean.
- Accepted deviations: the 维护者速读 has os-dev.md's four lines, not six; pins in the shared harness instead of per-card files (AGENTS.md shared-harness rule).
- Out of scope, not filed: a relation condition inside a top-level `and` node (a drill base filter with two or more parts) still reads as one 「View filter」 chip — the model reads every `and` node that way, and the card names only the single nested form; recorded in the PR's Acceptance notes.
- Landing: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 36529` ⇒ NOT governed, 357 changed lines ≤ 3000; no contract face (no spec schema, no `Clause-②: yes`, no narrowing) ⇒ no L2 owed; K = 2 (merge base `316f7571`), no locale-leg change on main since ⇒ area lands it.
